title: Hyperbolic generalized framed surfaces in hyperbolic 3-space
summary: Generalizing both hyperbolic framed surfaces and one-parameter families of hyperbolic framed curves, we introduce the concept of hyperbolic generalized framed surfaces and establish their relations in hyperbolic 3-space. We provide the necessary and sufficient conditions for a smooth surface to be a hyperbolic generalized framed base surface, followed by an analysis of the singularities of hyperbolic generalized framed base surfaces.
